text.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَىُّ ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓا۟ أَمَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: delayed sequential connector that resumes narration after an interval
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) makes the new action arrive after an interval, not as an immediate continuation. It stands at the boundary between the sealed dormancy of 18:11 and the raising in 18:12, so the conjunction itself carries the long gap before the awakening begins. Its independent form and pressed sound give that transition weight: the ayah first makes the reader feel delayed sequence, then moves into the divine act.

topics.headline: delayed sequence boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening connector structurally spans the dormancy period before the waking event is narrated.
topics.reason: QAC marks sequential ordering with temporal gap, and the CRITICAL boundary rows consistently connect the particle to the shift from sealed sleep in 18:11 to awakening in 18:12.

words.gloss_range: completed divine raising or rousing of the already-known group, with the object suffix making them acted upon
words.root_gloss_range: rousing from stillness, dispatching, raising the dead, setting in motion, and divine bringing forth; locally the transitive divine perfect selects rousing or raising while other branches remain as controlled resonance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the purpose clause attached to the raising verb

words.prose: {{ar:بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:baʿathnāhum}}) is a completed divine act aimed directly at the group through the attached object suffix. The morphology makes the sleepers patients of awakening rather than self-risers: the same divine agency that sealed the dormancy now releases them. The root field is broader than waking alone, so resurrection and dispatch resonances remain present as miniature proof and mission pressure, while the local transitive frame keeps the selected sense anchored in divine rousing. Structurally, the verb becomes the main act that receives {{ar:لِنَعْلَمَ}} ({{tr:li-naʿlama}}), tying awakening to disclosed knowledge and to the later dispatch echo in 18:19.

topics.headline: completed divine rousing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sleepers do not initiate the transition; the verb makes them direct recipients of a completed divine act.
topics.reason: QAC, attachment, and valency evidence support a perfect first-person plural verb with a clitic object, preserving divine agency and patienthood.

topics.headline: rousing-resurrection-dispatch field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cave waking is colored by resurrection and dispatch language without losing its local sense as rousing from sleep.
topics.reason: The accepted root branches include rousing, dispatching, and resurrection, but the local Form I transitive divine perfect with the sleepers as object narrows the active sense to rousing or raising.

topics.headline: raising to disclosure echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the raising immediately serves a knowledge-disclosure purpose and later returns as human sending in 18:19.
topics.reason: The verb governs the purpose clause in local syntax, and the supplied same-surah rows connect divine raising in 18:12 with the later human sending scene in 18:19.

words.gloss_range: purposive or resultive connector governing the following subjunctive verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the subjunctive knowledge verb governed by the purpose particle
the later relational lām phrase marking the object-domain of reckoning

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the small hinge that changes the ayah from event narration into purpose and outcome. It subordinates {{ar:نَعْلَمَ}} ({{tr:naʿlama}}) to the raising, so the knowledge-disclosure clause is not a second independent action. The later {{ar:لِمَا}} ({{tr:limā}}) uses a related surface beginning for a different function, which helps the verse frame both the purpose of waking and the object-domain of reckoning.

topics.headline: purpose-result hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the awakening is grammatically directed toward disclosed knowledge rather than merely followed by it.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence force the particle to govern the following subjunctive purpose verb, while the CRITICAL rows preserve the purpose/result nuance and the contrast with the later relational particle.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive first-person plural knowing or making-known in a purpose clause
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, distinguishing by marks, teaching, informing, and visible marking; locally the purpose clause selects knowledge as performative disclosure and differentiation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the interrogative subject opening the embedded question

words.prose: {{ar:نَعْلَمَ}} ({{tr:naʿlama}}) keeps the divine first-person plural subject inside the purpose clause, so the act of raising and the knowledge-disclosure share one agency arc. Because divine knowledge is not newly acquired, the verb functions performatively: the event brings the hidden duration into manifest differentiation. The voice variants make the pressure concrete: passive wording would make the knowledge event self-standing, and causative wording would foreground making known, while the local surface keeps divine cognition and disclosure fused. Syntactically, the verb governs the embedded question beginning with {{ar:أَىُّ}} ({{tr:ayyu}}), so the awakening becomes a test of which party's reckoning will be distinguished. The same formulaic pressure appears in trial-disclosure passages (47:31, 3:140, 29:3), and the cave narrative later returns to knowledge claims in 18:19, 18:21, 18:22, and 18:26.

topics.headline: performative divine disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause is not about God gaining information but about hidden truth becoming manifest through the event.
topics.reason: The local form keeps first-person divine knowing on the surface, while theological and semantic rows require narrowing that knowing toward performative disclosure rather than new acquisition.

topics.headline: voice and mood pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant pressure exposes the agency choices in this verb slot while the received local wording preserves divine first-person agency.
topics.reason: The variant rows are valid apparatus for agency and voice contrast, but local prose must be governed by the standard surface and its subjunctive dependence on the preceding particle.

topics.headline: embedded knowledge test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb opens a governed indirect question, turning divine action into an evaluated contest over duration.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following interrogative clause as the content complement of the knowledge verb, matching the CRITICAL rows about inquiry register and embedded question structure.

topics.headline: trial and cave knowledge thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this knowledge verb belongs to a wider trial-disclosure formula and begins a cave-narrative knowledge thread resolved later.
topics.reason: The supplied references explicitly connect the construction with trial-disclosure passages and with later same-surah knowledge claims, so the topic survives as provenance-aware commentary support.

words.gloss_range: declinable interrogative subject selecting one member from a bounded two-party set

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite dual party noun governed by the interrogative
the governing knowledge verb that embeds the question

words.prose: {{ar:أَىُّ}} ({{tr:ayyu}}) opens the embedded question as the grammatical subject, so the unresolved selection becomes the center of the test. In construct with {{ar:ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥizbayni}}), it does not ask an open-ended question; it asks which one from a closed pair. Because it is governed by {{ar:نَعْلَمَ}} ({{tr:naʿlama}}), the interrogative force becomes an issue to be disclosed by the awakening rather than a direct question to an addressee.

topics.headline: bounded interrogative subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse frames the test as a forced selection from two parties before the reckoning predicate is reached.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word the nominative interrogative subject and the head of a construct relation with the dual party noun.

words.gloss_range: the two definite parties or factions forming the closed comparison set
words.root_gloss_range: party, faction, aligned group, allotted portion, pressing matter, and compact roughness; locally the noun selects party or faction while related pressure and alignment imagery remain bounded background
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥizbayni}}) supplies the closed two-column set for the question. Its dual ending blocks a many-party reading, and its definiteness presupposes an identifiable pair even though the ayah does not name them. The root's factional field keeps the pair from sounding like a neutral count of people: they are alignments or parties tested by reckoning. Broader confederation echoes, including 33:20 and 33:22, add background factional pressure, but the local dual form narrows the scene to two contestants over the cave duration.

topics.headline: definite dual party set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reckoning contest is grammatically closed to exactly two identifiable parties, not an open field of claimants.
topics.reason: The word is definite, dual, and genitive under the preceding construct interrogative, making the two parties the bounded set from which the answer must be selected.

topics.headline: factional alignment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun carries factional alignment pressure while the local context leaves the two parties' exact identities unspecified.
topics.reason: The root supports party and faction meanings, and cross-surah confederation rows are relevant background, but the local noun remains an unnamed dual set rather than a hostile coalition scene.

words.gloss_range: reckoned, enumerated, or was more exact in counting; the surface permits verbal and elative construals
words.root_gloss_range: pebbles, counting by number until encompassed, retained reckoning, settled judgment, sharpness, and other remote branches; locally the counting and comprehensive reckoning branch is selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the final duration noun specifying the counted span

words.prose: {{ar:أَحْصَىٰ}} ({{tr:aḥṣā}}) is the hinge where the two parties become measurable by performance. If read as a perfect verb, it asks which party actually enumerated the stay; if read as an elative predicate, it asks which was more exact in reckoning. That ambiguity is productive because either parse makes precision the test. The root's pebble-counting and retention imagery makes the hidden sleep feel countable unit by unit, while the local frame narrows the word to exhaustive reckoning rather than unrelated root branches. Its position between the prior counted-years signal and {{ar:أَمَدًا}} ({{tr:amadan}}) turns raw duration into accountable, bounded measure, with record-accounting echoes in 18:49, 36:12, 58:6, and 78:29 keeping the count from sounding like anecdotal memory.

topics.headline: verb-elative reckoning ambiguity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same surface can ask either who counted or who was more exact, making precision itself the structural issue.
topics.reason: QAC explicitly marks the form as ambiguous between Form IV perfect and elative, while local syntax licenses the interrogative subject and following measure phrase.

topics.headline: exhaustive counting and retention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contest is about comprehensive, retained reckoning rather than a rough estimate of time.
topics.reason: The accepted branch for counting by number until encompassed supports exhaustive reckoning, while local grammar narrows away remote pebble, judgment, and bodily disease branches.

topics.headline: accounting pivot and echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word connects party identity to counted duration and places the cave stay in an exact-accounting field.
topics.reason: The word is the predicate or verbal core of the embedded question and the supplied rows connect it to prior counted years and record-accounting contexts such as 18:49, 36:12, 58:6, and 78:29.

words.gloss_range: compact relational phrase meaning for what, with respect to what, or for their remaining

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earlier purpose lām contrasted with this relational phrase
the reckoning word that the relational phrase connects to the remaining clause
the remaining verb nested as the measured domain

words.prose: {{ar:لِمَا}} ({{tr:limā}}) is the relational hinge between reckoning and remaining. Unlike the earlier purposive {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}), this form marks the object-domain of counting: the reckoning is about what they remained or about their remaining. That relative-measure reading dominates, but the possible causal shade still lets the duration itself feel like the reason the reckoning matters. Its fused surface keeps the relation compact and prevents {{ar:لَبِثُوا}} ({{tr:labithū}}) from becoming a simple direct object of {{ar:أَحْصَىٰ}} ({{tr:aḥṣā}}); the stay is nested as the domain to be measured.

topics.headline: relational duration domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counting reaches the stay through a compact relational phrase, making remaining the measured domain rather than a flat object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the form as the prepositional complement of the reckoning word and as the compressed relative measure phrase governing the remaining clause.

topics.headline: relative source-like compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact form keeps both the duration and the act of remaining in view while the local reading remains primarily relative-measure, not causal.
topics.reason: The relative and source-like possibilities are meaningful, but the local syntax and attachment evidence narrow the function to a relative measure domain for the count.

words.gloss_range: they remained, stayed, tarried, or lingered, presented as a completed past state
words.root_gloss_range: remaining in a place, staying, abiding, delaying, lingering, and slowness; locally the Form I perfect selects completed remaining, with imposed-duration pressure supplied by the narrative context

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the relational phrase under which the remaining verb is nested

words.prose: {{ar:لَبِثُوا}} ({{tr:labithū}}) supplies the counted event, but it is nested under {{ar:لِمَا}} ({{tr:limā}}), not made the main action of the ayah. Its perfect form closes the period of remaining as a completed past state, making it available for reckoning after the raising. The third-person plural ending carries the same group without renaming them, while the root's staying and lingering field makes the sleep a prolonged state endured in place. Causative delay forms remain background only: the local Form I presents their remaining, while the imposed force comes from the wider divine sealing and raising frame. The root then becomes a cave-narrative duration thread, returning in 18:19, 18:25, and 18:26.

topics.headline: completed measurable remaining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the stay is already over and is grammatically nested as the event being measured.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as perfect Form I, and attachment evidence places it inside the relative measure phrase governed by the preceding relational form.

topics.headline: endured stasis pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb makes the duration feel like prolonged, passive remaining in place, while causation is supplied by the surrounding divine acts rather than by this form itself.
topics.reason: The root supports staying and lingering, and the narrative supports imposed duration, but the local Form I must not be turned into an explicit causative verb.

topics.headline: cave duration thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this verb starts a same-surah duration thread that later becomes the sleepers' own question and then a knowledge resolution.
topics.reason: The supplied rows explicitly connect the root to 18:19, 18:25, and 18:26, so the echo survives as a duration-thread topic without controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite accusative duration span or bounded extent specifying what was reckoned
words.root_gloss_range: bounded term, endpoint, duration, and extent, including spatial extent by analogy; locally the temporal bounded-span sense is selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the reckoning word whose countable horizon is specified by the final duration noun
the opening delayed-sequence particle echoed by the final duration word

words.prose: {{ar:أَمَدًا}} ({{tr:amadan}}) lands as the ayah's final specification: the contest concerns a bounded time-span. Its accusative function completes the reckoning frame, and its indefiniteness leaves the exact number undisclosed at this point. The root's endpoint and extent field makes the hidden sleep feel like a finite stretch whose far edge must be reckoned, while the local temporal context narrows any road-extent image into analogy rather than a spatial reading. The word also avoids indefinite perpetuity and appointed-term framing, choosing a countable horizon suited to {{ar:أَحْصَىٰ}} ({{tr:aḥṣā}}). As an uncommon duration term in final position, it returns to the opening delay of {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) and links the prior counted-years cadence to the bounded duration now under dispute.

topics.headline: accusative duration specifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word specifies the domain of the contest as temporal extent, not the sleepers' number, identity, or location.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an accusative specification or counted extent completing the reckoning construction.

topics.headline: bounded endpoint duration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen duration word names a finite horizon with an endpoint, not endless time or merely an appointed term.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports bounded span and endpoint, while local syntax selects the temporal sense and keeps spatial extent as image rather than direct referent.

topics.headline: measured but unspecified close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the span is measurable and finite, yet its exact quantity remains withheld by the indefinite ending.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite form and final tanwīn rows support a close that is grammatically bounded but numerically unspecified.

topics.headline: rare closing duration chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that an uncommon duration term closes the ayah and links the prior counted years to the present reckoning question.
topics.reason: The bundle warns that the strict hapax claim is too strong because occurrence evidence gives a small field rather than a single root occurrence, so rarity survives as constrained uncommonness.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Awakening converts duration into disclosed difference.** `ع ل م` B001 (“knowing a thing as it becomes clear”) follows resurrection and precedes competition in reckoning. Their later guesses collapse into “your Lord knows best” (18:19), while 18:25–26 separates counted years from divine knowledge. I infer that being raised stages and reveals the parties’ differing epistemic capacities. The purpose clause reads as manifested distinction, not information extracted from ignorance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:25–26 corrected human counting without abolishing measure, confirming the distinction between calculation and encompassing knowledge.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Knowledge staged as exhaustive reckoning.** `ح ص ي/B002` is counting until the object is encompassed. `ٱلرَّقِيم` (18:9), `سِنِينَ عَدَدًا` (18:11), and the rival parties in this ayah create a record–measure–comparison sequence. I infer that awakening makes competing accounts testable against an encompassed duration. `لِنَعْلَمَ` therefore reads here through an enacted audit: latent claims become manifest in countable performance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:13’s truthful sequential account and 18:17’s mapped solar course broadened reckoning from number alone to ordered trace.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki özel söz biçiminin yaşlı kadın anlamına geldiğini ve biçimlerinden birinde ek sesler bulunduğunu açıkça bildirir. Sağlanan çerçeve hem insan referansını hem de biçimsel sınırlamayı doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel yaşlılık kavramı değil, yaşlı kadını bildiren iki özel söz biçimidir; sözcük yapısına ilişkin ek ses bilgisi anlamın yerine geçirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kanıtta verilen iki özel söz biçimine bağlı yaşlı kadın anlamını kapsar; genel yaşlı kişi veya her türlü yaşlılık anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaşlı bir kadını belirten iki özel söz biçimidir. Biçimlerin yapısında ek sesler bulunduğuna ilişkin açıklama, kişi anlamından ayrı bir biçim bilgisi olarak kalır.

facets.statement: Özel söz biçimi yaşlı bir kadını belirtir.
Aynı yaşlı kadın anlamı sesçe değişik ikinci bir söz biçimiyle de aktarılır.
Söz biçimindeki bazı seslerin sonradan eklenmiş olduğu ayrıca belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt temel özel söz biçiminde yaşlı kadın anlamında birleşir ve sesçe değişen ikinci biçimi de verir. Ek seslere ilişkin çözümleme, anlam alanını genişleten yeni bir kişi türü değildir.

concept_gloss.text: yaşlı kadını belirten özel söz biçimi
concept_gloss.applicability: Kavramı genel yaşlılığa genişletmeden iki özel söz biçiminin ortak kişi anlamını verir.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşlı kadın referansını ve anlamın belirli söz biçimleriyle sınırlı oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özel söz biçiminin bir kişiye gönderimde bulunduğu doğal metin bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kadın ve yaşlı oluşunu eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Anlamın yalnız belirli söz biçimlerine bağlı oluşunu ve bu biçimlerdeki ek ses bilgisini göstermez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yaşlı bir kadını belirtme alanında doğrudan örtüşürler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özel iki söz biçiminin kadın referansıdır; komşu dal genel yaşlı kişi anlamını ve mecazen eski nesneleri de içine alan daha geniş bir alandır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kadının ilerleyen yaşına göre adlandırılması alanında kesişirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ölçütü yaşlılık niteliğidir; komşu dal ise yaklaşık bir yaş eşiğine bağlı daha belirli ve daha erken bir evreyi anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi özel söz biçimini karada yetişen bir havuç türünün adı olarak tanımlar ve onu denizle ilişkilendirilen başka bir havuç adından ayırır. Sağlanan bitki çerçevesi bu tekil tanıklığı aşmadan aynı referansı korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal küçük taşları ve bunlarla kaplı araziyi kapsar; sayma, zihinsel nitelik, kokulu madde parçası ve mesane hastalığı anlamlarını kapsamaz.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, küçük taşların topluluğudur.

Belirli bir arazi yapısı, üzerinde küçük taşlar bulunması bakımından nitelenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi saymayı, sayıyı eksiksiz elde etmeyi ve sayısal ayrıntıların tümünü bilgiyle kuşatmayı aynı çekirdekte toplar. Çakıl çokluğuna dayanan büyük sayı anlatımı bu çekirdeğin mecazlı uzantısıdır, çekirdeğin yerine geçmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kesin sayma ve sayıyı eksiksiz belirleme alanındadır; tahmin, genel hesap işlemleri ve yalnız çokluk bildiren kullanımlar çekirdeğin tamamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, sayma çekirdeğini korurken büyük sayı, tam kuşatma ve bağlama özgü koruma ya da güç yetirme yorumlarını ayrı tutar; kalıplı okumalar yalın anlama genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sayarak miktarını belirlemek ve sayısal ayrıntıların tamamını eksiksiz bilgiyle kuşatmaktır. Çakılın çokluğuna benzetilen büyük sayı anlatımı bunun bağımlı bir uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin birimleri sayılarak sayısı belirlenir.
Sayım, bütün birimlerin eksiksiz kapsanması ve sayının bilgiyle kuşatılması düzeyine ulaşabilir.
Çakılın sayıca çokluğu, çok büyük bir sayıyı anlatan benzetmeye kaynak olur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği sayma yoluyla miktarı elde etmektir; daha güçlü anlatımlarda bütün birimleri eksiksiz sayma ve sayının tamamını bilgiyle kuşatma vurgulanır. Çakıl çokluğu da büyük sayının benzetmeli ifadesini sağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayma eylemiyle birlikte sayılanların tümünü kapsama ve sonucu eksiksiz bilme çekirdeğini temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Sayma işlemini, eksiksiz kapsamı ve sayının kesin bilgisine ulaşmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin birimlerini tek tek sayarak miktarını bulma bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Eksiksiz bilgiyle bütün sayıyı kuşatma vurgusunu zorunlu olarak taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sayımın hiçbir birimi dışarıda bırakmadan kesin sonuca ulaştığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Gerçek sayma işlemini ve sayının eksiksiz bilgisini ifade etmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi akıl ve zihinsel sağlamlığı ağırbaşlılıkla birleştirir; bazı yapılarda buna tedbirli davranma, ketumluk ve sırrını koruma eklenir. Bunlar ilgisiz anlamlar değil, sağlam aklın davranışta görülen özel sonuçlarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız zihinsel kapasiteyi değil ağırbaşlı, tedbirli ve gerektiğinde ketum davranışı kapsar; söz keskinliği ve sayma anlamı bunun parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, akıl ve ağırbaşlılık çekirdeğini korur; ketumluk ve sırrını saklama yalnız bunları açıkça bildiren kişi nitelemelerine bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Sağlam ve güçlü aklın ağırbaşlılık, sağduyu ve kendini denetleme olarak görünmesidir. Bazı kişi nitelemelerinde bu nitelik tedbirli olmayı, ketumluğu ve sırrını korumayı da içerir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, kişinin sağlam ve güçlü bir akla sahip olmasıdır.
Bu zihinsel sağlamlık ağırbaşlılık ve ölçülü davranış olarak görünür.
Belirli kişi nitelemelerinde tedbirli, ketum ve sır saklayan olma vurgusu eklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı akıl, zihinsel güç ve ağırbaşlılık çevresinde kurar; kişi niteleyen bazı yapılarda sağlam aklın sonucu olarak tedbir, ketumluk ve sırrını koruma özellikleri de belirtilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin güçlü aklıyla birlikte ölçülü ve dengeli davranmasının anlatıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli dil yapısında sözdeki sivrilik ve keskinliği doğrudan destekler. Bunun yanında aktarılan bir sözdeki benzer biçim başka bir aktarımda doğru okuma sayılmadığından, o metin dal için bağımsız bir anlam kanıtı olarak kullanılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız dilin sivri ve keskin oluşunu bildiren yapıya bağlıdır; tartışmalı metin biçimi yeni bir anlam oluşturmaz ve genel konuşma yeteneğine genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız dilin sivriliğini bildiren sabit yapıya bağlıdır; bu anlam yalın biçime veya benzer görünen tartışmalı metin aktarımına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir dil yapısında, kişinin sözlerinin sivri, sert ve keskin oluşunu anlatır. Benzer biçimli tartışmalı bir metin aktarımı bu yapının anlamını genişletmez.

facets.statement: Yapı, dilin söz söylerken sivri ve keskin oluşunu niteler.
Benzer görünen bir metin biçimi aktarılmış, ancak başka aktarımda doğru okuma farklı kabul edilmiştir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, dilin sözdeki sivriliğini ve keskinliğini bildiren yapıyı destekler. Benzer biçimli bir metin aktarımının doğru okumasına ilişkin kaynak farkı, bu dal için bağımsız bir anlam kanıtı oluşturmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, misk adı verilen kokulu maddeden oluşan katı bir parçayı ve bunun söz konusu maddenin kesesinde bulunduğunu açıkça belirtir. Parçanın katılığı taş anlamıyla benzerlik kurar, ancak gönderim gerçek bir taş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız misk maddesinin katı parçasını bildiren yapıya bağlıdır; genel taş, başka maddelerin parçası veya kokunun kendisi anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız misk maddesinin katı parçasını adlandıran yapıya bağlıdır; parça anlamı yalın biçime veya bütün kokulu maddelere genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Misk adı verilen kokulu maddeden oluşan katı bir parçadır; özellikle bu maddenin bulunduğu kesenin içindeki parça anlatılır.

facets.statement: Gönderim, misk maddesinden oluşan tek ve katı bir parçadır.
Parça, misk maddesini taşıyan kesenin içinde bulunan katı oluşum olarak belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar misk maddesinin her bir katı parçasını bu yapıyla adlandırır ve parçanın söz konusu kokulu maddenin kesesinde bulunduğunu belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: misk kesesindeki katı koku maddesi parçası

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı bir seyin son noktasi, eristigi gaye, omur veya sure icin sinir ve yarista varilan hedef olarak verir. Verilen cerceve, hem genel son-sinir anlamini hem de belirli kullanimlardaki omur ve yaris hedefi uzantilarini tasir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal mutlak sonsuzluk veya genel zaman degil, bir seyin sinirla iliskili sonu ve varis noktasidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ciplak ad bir son ve sinir fikrini tasir; soru ve yaris kullanislari bu cekirdekten ayrilmadan kendi baglamlariyla sinirlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyin yoneldigi veya ona kadar uzandigi son sinir, vade ya da varis noktasi; omur ve sure icin bitis cizgisi, yarista ise ulasilacak hedef olarak belirir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, bir seyin sonu, siniri ve eristigi gaye noktasidir.
Omur, ecel veya sure soz konusu oldugunda anlam sinirli bir zaman araliginin bitisine uygulanir.
Yaris baglaminda atlarin suruldugu ve rekabetin ona dogru yapildigi hedef noktasini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali son, gaye ve sinir ekseninde toplar; zamanla ilgili kullanimda omrun veya vadenin bitisi, yarista da varilacak hedef olarak aciklanir. Sure boyutu, mutlak zamandan cok belirli bir sinira gore kavranan zaman araligidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel cekirdegi, vade ve hedef boyutunu birlikte veren en kisa dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Sonluk, sinir, gaye ve ulasilan hedef fikrini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Omur, ecel veya sure baglaminda sinirli zamanin bitis noktasini vermek icin uygundur.
